75188-social-process.title: Social Process
75188-social-process.creator: Unknown
75188-social-process.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. An impersonal form, I should say, is one whose life history is not identified with that of particular persons. A myth, for example, has a history of its own which you would never discover in the biography of individuals, and although it exists in the minds of men it cannot be seen intelligibly except by regarding it as a distinct whole for which human thought is only a medium.

arxiv-2012-03166.title: Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks for Optimal Path Planning
arxiv-2012-03166.creator: Nachuan Ma, Jiankun Wang, Max Q.-H. Meng, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2012-03166.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Nachuan Ma, Jiankun Wang, Max Q.-H. Meng, Fellow, IEEE. Path planning plays an important role in autonomous robot systems. Effective understanding of the surrounding environment and efficient generation of optimal collision-free path are both critical parts for solving path planning problem.

arxiv-2104-01241.title: TreeToaster : Towards an IVM-Optimized Compiler CCS: Information systems Database views CCS: Information systems Query optimization
arxiv-2104-01241.creator: Darshana Balakrishnan, Carl Nuessle, Oliver Kennedy, Lukasz Ziarek
arxiv-2104-01241.description: Abstract . A compiler’s optimizer operates over abstract syntax trees (ASTs), continuously applying rewrite rules to replace subtrees of the AST with more efficient ones. Especially on large source repositories, even simply finding opportunities for a rewrite can be expensive, as optimizer traverses the AST naively.

arxiv-2211-12671.title: 3-D Positioning and Resource Allocation for Multi-UAV Base Stations Under Blockage-Aware Channel Model
arxiv-2211-12671.creator: Pengfei Yi, Lipeng Zhu, Zhenyu Xiao, Rui Zhang, Zhu Han, Xiang-Gen Xia
arxiv-2211-12671.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Pengfei Yi, Lipeng Zhu, Zhenyu Xiao, Rui Zhang, Zhu Han, Xiang-Gen Xia. In this paper, we propose to deploy multiple unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) mounted base stations to serve ground users in outdoor environments with obstacles. In particular, the geographic information is employed to capture the blockage effects for air-to-ground (A2G) links caused by buildings, and a realistic blockage-aware A2G channel model is proposed to characterize the continuous variation of the channels at different locations.

arxiv-2308-04301.title: Electronic correlations in promising room-temperature superconductor Pb 9 Cu(PO 4 ) 6 O: a DFT+DMFT study
arxiv-2308-04301.creator: Dmitry M. Korotin, Dmitry Y. Novoselov, Alexey O. Shorikov, Vladimir I. Anisimov, Artem R. Oganov
arxiv-2308-04301.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dmitry M. Korotin, Dmitry Y. Novoselov, Alexey O. Shorikov, Vladimir I. Anisimov, Artem R. Oganov. We present results of the first investigations on the correlated nature of electronic states that cross the Fermi level in Pb 9 Cu(PO 4 ) 6 O aka LK-99 obtained within the DFT + DMFT approach. Coulomb correlations between Cu- d d electrons led to the opening of the band gap between the extra-O p p and Cu d x ​ z / d y ​ z d_{xz}/d_{yz} states.

arxiv-2410-14083.title: SAMReg: SAM-enabled Image Registration with ROI-based Correspondence
arxiv-2410-14083.creator: Shiqi Huang, Tingfa Xu, Ziyi Shen, Shaheer Ullah Saeed, Wen Yan, Dean Barratt, Yipeng Hu
arxiv-2410-14083.description: Abstract This paper describes a new spatial correspondence representation based on paired regions-of-interest (ROIs), for medical image registration. The distinct properties of the proposed ROI-based correspondence are discussed, in the context of potential benefits in clinical applications following image registration, compared with alternative correspondence-representing approaches, such as those based on sampled displacements and spatial transformation functions.

pmc-11643766.creator: Irene da Silva Araújo Gonçalves, Mariana De Santis Filgueiras, Tiago Ricardo Moreira, Milena Sales Thomé, Gabrielly Luisa Diniz Paiva, Geralda Patrícia de Almeida, Rosangela Minardi Mitre Cotta, Tatiana do Nascimento Campos, Dayse Mara de Oliveira Freitas, Juliana Farias de Novaes, Alex Fabrício de
pmc-11643766.description: Background/Objectives: Obesity is influenced by biological, hormonal, and social factors, contributing to chronic diseases and burdening the healthcare system. Chronic stress and emotional eating are linked to weight gain, affecting eating behaviors and metabolism. This study aimed to assess the association between stress, eating behavior, and adiposity in obese women.

pmc-12563418.creator: Boris Ryabko, Nadezhda Savina, Yeshewas Getachew Lulu, Yunfei Han, Wray Buntine
pmc-12563418.description: In this paper, we apply an information-theoretic method proposed by Ryabko and Savina (therefore called the RS-method), based on the use of data compression, to recognize the individual author’s style of a writer across four languages from different language groups and families.

pmc-12607541.title: Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices Toward Weight Management Among Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Saudi Arabia: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12607541.creator: Miyad Khazna, Abdullah Zaki Al-Fahd, Jomanah Atyah Alatawi, Badriah Almotiri, Remas Abdulrahman Alduwaish, Rahaf Alanazi, Khalid Albedaiwi, Sharfuddin Chowdhury, Herbert Franz Jelinek
pmc-12607541.description: Background/Objectives: Weight management is crucial for preventing and managing diabetes. This study aimed to evaluate the knowledge, attitude, and practice (KAP) of people with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) regarding weight management in Saudi Arabia. Methods: This cross-sectional survey of patients with T2DM in Saudi Arabia was conducted from October 2024 to February 2025.

pmc-12645604.title: Antibiotic stewardship in suspected neutropenic fever (ASTERIC trial): a multicentre, type 1 hybrid effectiveness-implementation, stepped-wedge, randomised controlled trial study protocol
pmc-12645604.creator: Timothy H Rainer, Rex Pui Kin Lam, Tat Chi Tsang, Abraham Ka-Chung Wai, Siu Chung Leung, Rock Yuk Yan Leung, Carlos King Ho Wong, Harinder Gill, Wendy W T Lam, Wendy Wing Lok Chan, Arthur Chi Kin Cheung, Man Ting Lau, Shun Fung Lee, Yu Fai Choi, Henry Fong Lun Lee, Ka Leung Mok, Ho Chuen Lam, Shi Ye
pmc-12645604.description: IntroductionNeutropenic fever (NF) has a crude mortality rate of 3–18%. International guidelines recommend that all patients with NF receive ultrabroad-spectrum antibiotics (UBSAs) within 1 hour of emergency department (ED) registration. However, over 70% patients presenting to hospital with suspected NF (sNF) cannot access absolute neutrophil count (ANC) result within 1 hour, do not have NF and do not require UBSAs.

pmc-12965841.title: Factor XIII Deficiency: A Silent Bleeder Behind a Normal Coagulation Profile
pmc-12965841.creator: Ramesh Yadav, Madhav Raj Karki, Dikshya Pokhrel, Aron Neupane, Kshitiz Parajuli, Hem Sagar Rimal
pmc-12965841.description: Factor XIII deficiency is a rare cause of bleeding disorder. An 8‐month‐old male infant presented with persistent bleeding from a minor lip cut injury, which was sustained 2 days prior. The bleeding did not stop despite local hemostatic measures. His medical history was notable for spontaneous intradermal bleeds at different times and umbilical stump bleeding during the neonatal period.

pmc-13116114.title: Peptoid-based antimicrobial strategies against polymyxin-resistant Gram-negative bacteria
pmc-13116114.creator: Shyam Kumar Mishra, Jiawei Shen, Tanzina Akter, Abiye Tigabu, Umme Laila Urmi, Meseret Alem Damtie, Elias Shiferaw Mekonen, Rajesh Kuppusamy, Kristian Sørensen, Jennifer S Lin, Edgar H H Wong, Alex Hui, Annelise E Barron, Mark Willcox
pmc-13116114.description: AimsPolymyxins remain the mainstay antibiotic for the treatment of infections caused by multidrug-resistant bacteria. However, with the increase in the use of polymyxins, the simultaneous rise of polymyxin-resistance cases has been another global threat, necessitating the need for novel therapeutic strategies. This work aimed to evaluate the antibacterial activity of cationic peptoids against polymyxin-resistant bacteria of global priority.

pmc-13515032.title: Clinical Evaluation of a Tandem qPCR-CRISPR Assay for Multidrug-Resistant or Rifampicin-Resistant Tuberculosis: A Prospective Diagnostic Accuracy Study
pmc-13515032.creator: Ying Wang, Zhe Song, Jianfeng Zeng, Yajuan Dong, Houming Liu, Jian Zeng, Xuhui Liu, Liang Fu, Xuelin Li, Shuihua Lu, Zhen Huang, Xiao-Yong Fan
pmc-13515032.description: CRISPR-based assays have shown the potential to enhance the diagnosis of tuberculosis (TB), but evidence remains limited owing to scarce independent validation. We prospectively evaluated a tandem qPCR-CRISPR assay detecting Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) and rifampicin resistance. Respiratory specimens for smear microscopy, mycobacterial culture, Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra (Xpert) and the investigational assay were collected from suspected TB patients.

pmc-13560942.title: Tenofovir in Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
pmc-13560942.creator: Julia Lier, Achmed Mrestani, Max Braune, Mario Hönemann, Johann Otto Pelz, Jost-Julian Rumpf, Florian Then Bergh
pmc-13560942.description: ObjectivesProgressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) is a rare, often fatal demyelinating disease of the CNS caused by reactivation of the JC polyomavirus (JCV), typically in immunocompromised individuals. As no specific therapy against JCV exists, current management focuses on immune reconstitution. Recently, a potential therapeutic effect of tenofovir was reported.
